mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% in the most recent month.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with strong job growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k in the prior month) signals robust consumer demand and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market expansion regimes (HOUST above its 12-month moving average), rising home construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in periods where HOUST > 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) and robust consumer spending (RSAFS above its 12-month average) signals a healthy economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% AND RSAFS > 12-month average
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and RSAFS > 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its historical average reflects robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% indicates a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.
